summary: Replication receivers stop expired exchange work before writer admission or between committed phases and return signed retryable overload responses for receive deadlines and local receive timeouts.

replay.detail: Receipts remain atomic and retries use existing envelope deduplication.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: An optional connector-to-daemon deadline header changes only the local process contract. Missing headers preserve existing behavior; older daemons ignore the header. Signed peer messages are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Abandoned exchanges remain unacknowledged; retries resume complete durable receipts without inserting duplicate claims.
